title: Why flattening the P-value histogram works: a theory of the standard-deviation optimization in tensor-decomposition-based unsupervised feature extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.29201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Tensor-decomposition-based unsupervised feature extraction (TD-based UFE) selects genes by attributing P-values to the components of a gene singular vector under a null normal distribution. The standard deviation sigma of this distribution is unknown and is chosen so that the histogram of the P-values of the genes that are not selected becomes as flat as possible. This heuristic has worked well in practice but has had no theoretical justification. Results: We prove, for a model of signal, mean expression and noise, that the higher-order singular value decomposition has a component that reproduces the experimental design, that the components of its gene singular vector belonging to background genes are approximately normal with standard deviation sigma_0 = sqrt(d)/s, where d is the noise variance and s the singular value, and that signal genes separate from the background even when they form a positive fraction of all genes.

translated_title: 为什么拉平P值直方图有效：基于张量分解的无监督特征提取中标准差优化的理论
translated_abstract: 背景：基于张量分解的无监督特征提取（TD-based UFE）通过在零假设正态分布下将P值归因于基因奇异向量的各个分量来筛选基因。该分布的标准差σ是未知的，其选取方式是使未被选中的基因的P值直方图尽可能平坦。这种启发式方法在实践中效果良好，但一直缺乏理论依据。结果：我们针对包含信号、平均表达和噪声的模型证明：高阶奇异值分解具有能够重现实验设计的分量；其基因奇异向量中属于背景基因的分量近似服从标准差为σ₀ = √d/s的正态分布（其中d为噪声方差，s为奇异值）；并且即使信号基因构成全部基因的一个正比例，它们也能与背景基因分离。
tldr: 该论文首次为基于张量分解的无监督特征提取中“拉平P值直方图以优化标准差”这一启发式方法提供了理论证明，表明背景基因的分量近似服从标准差为√d/s的正态分布，且信号基因即使占全部基因的正比例也能与背景分离。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first theoretical justification for the heuristic of flattening the P-value histogram to optimize the standard deviation in tensor-decomposition-based unsupervised feature extraction, proving that background genes are approximately normal with standard deviation √d/s and that signal genes separate from the background even when they form a positive fraction of all genes.
